name: Hashashin
bible: A slender, lithe young woman with a light, coiled build and a low, ready stance. FACE: pale warm skin, sharp narrow dark eyes under straight black brows, and a black cloth veil over the nose and mouth to just below the eyes, its top edge lined with a thin gold stitch. HAIR: straight black hair, mostly hidden under the hood, with one loose strand at the temple. COSTUME: a deep indigo hood with a gold-embroidered rim, falling into an indigo cloak lining at the shoulders; a sleeveless near-black lacquered bodice with thin gold trim, black fingerless gauntlets with gold cuffs, black wrapped bracers, fitted indigo leggings, a gold-buckled belt, and black calf-high boots. A soft indigo scarf tail streams behind her. WEAPON: a pair of short, slim, lightly curved knives, each blade no longer than the hand from wrist to fingertip, narrow dark steel, black wrapped grips and a small gold crossguard. She holds one in each hand in forward grip: RIGHT hand on the right knife, LEFT on the left, blades angled out. Her energy and Flash Step after-images are CYAN light (#3ce0f5) with pale white cores, drawn as ghostly copies of her pose.
design:
- top row: full-body neutral stance facing right, lithe and slender; a low combat stance with both knives in forward grip; a walking pose; a running pose; a jump; a close-up of the veil and eyes under the hood
- middle rows: six attack and special poses: quick forward thrusts, crossing slashes, a leaping double cut, a downward plunge, a spinning cut with cyan trails, a Flash Step after-image pose with cyan ghosts
- bottom row: guard, hit reaction, knocked down, a victory pose, the Flash Step special with a cluster of cyan after-images

run.title: Run cycle (8 frames, loops from frame 8 back to frame 1)
frames: run cycle 1: right foot contact, stride long and light, torso leaning forward, knives held forward-grip at the sides, a faint cyan after-image trailing behind
run cycle 2: right foot down, body at its lowest, scarf streaming back, cyan after-image close behind
run cycle 3: passing pose, left knee driving forward, the left knife held out to the side, body rising
run cycle 4: left leg reaching forward, body at its highest, both feet briefly off the ground, knives drawn in close
run cycle 5: left foot contact, stride long and light (the mirror of frame 1), torso leaning forward
run cycle 6: left foot down, body at its lowest, scarf streaming back, cyan after-image close behind
run cycle 7: passing pose, right knee driving forward, the right knife held out to the side, body rising
run cycle 8: right leg reaching forward, body at its highest, both feet off the ground, knives drawn in close

atk-a.title: Basic combo strikes 1 and 2: quick thrusts and crossing cuts (3 frames each)
frames: combo strike 1, anticipation: the right knife drawn back at the shoulder in forward grip, body turned side-on, the veil edge lifting, a faint cyan after-image
combo strike 1, strike: a fast forward thrust with the right knife, arm straight, the knife point leading, a short cyan trail kept inside this cell
combo strike 1, recovery: the knife pulled back into guard, body light on the balls of the feet
combo strike 2, anticipation: the left knife swept across behind the head, weight rolling onto the toes, a cyan trace behind the hand
combo strike 2, strike: a quick crossing slash with the left knife across the body, a sharp cyan arc kept inside this cell, the scarf snapping outward
combo strike 2, recovery: both knives back in forward guard, the body already turning toward the next cut

atk-b.title: Combo finisher and aerial attack: leaping double cut and mid-air spin (3 frames each)
frames: combo finisher, anticipation: a fast crouch, both knives low and crossed at the hips, body coiled, a cyan after-image starting behind her
combo finisher, strike: a leaping double cut, both knives sweeping forward in a wide arc as she springs off the ground, a large cyan arc trail kept inside this cell, the strongest pose
combo finisher, recovery: landing into a long stretched pose, knives flared out wide, scarf and veil flaring, the after-images fading
aerial attack, anticipation: in mid-air, body folded, both knives drawn in close to the chest, a cyan after-image trailing
aerial attack, strike: a spinning mid-air slash, one knife sweeping across in front, a cyan arc trail kept inside this cell
aerial attack, recovery: airborne, body tucked, knives returned to forward guard, the scarf streaming upward

atk-c.title: Plunge attack and heavy attack: knife dive and whirling cut flurry (3 frames each)
frames: plunge, dive: diving straight down feet-first, both knives pointed at the ground under the body, cyan speed streaks
plunge, impact: landing in a low crouch, both knives driven into the ground in front, a burst of cyan light and dust kept inside this cell
plunge, recovery: rising from the impact, the knives pulled free and returned to forward guard
heavy attack, charge: body coiled low, both knives drawn back far behind the body, a cyan glow building along the blades
heavy attack, strike: a whirling spin into a flurry of cuts, the body turning with both knives extended, a huge cyan arc of cuts kept inside this cell
heavy attack, follow-through: the spin ends in a poised pose, the knives crossed in front, cyan after-images dissolving

sheetNotes.idle: Both knives held forward-grip at the hips, blades angled out; the veil and hood stay still; a faint cyan after-image shimmers at the edge of the stance.
sheetNotes.air: In the air she holds both knives forward-grip and tucks her knees; the scarf tail streams behind; cyan after-images trail on fast moves.
sheetNotes.dash: Ground dash: she stretches forward into a flat blur with a cyan after-image trailing, the scarf snapping back. Air dash: the same stretched line through the air.
sheetNotes.hurt: Show the pain on her face: eyes squeezed, the veil pulling down with a gasp, the hood knocked back. Both knives stay in hand.
sheetNotes.art: Flash Step: anticipation 1-2, she sinks low and her figure splits into two cyan after-images, the instant before the blink. Execution 3-4, the blink: her body is a cyan streak sweeping across the cell, leaving three after-images, the knives crossed; then the six-cut flurry, six cyan arc slashes around her body kept inside the cell, the knives blurring. Recovery 5-6, the flurry ends, she lands in a low crouch as the after-images dissolve, then rises back to her stance.
sheetNotes.misc: Skill throw: the thrown item is a single slim knife thrown overhand with the right hand, a short cyan trail behind it. Taunt: she spins one knife around her fingers in a quick flourish, then rises with a slow, confident head tilt, a cyan after-image behind her. Victory: she crosses the two knives in front of her chest, blades down, the scarf stirring, a cyan after-image shimmering beside her.
sheetNotes.ko: Intro: she walks in quietly with both knives lowered and the hood up; she lifts the knives to a salute in front of her veil, twirls them once in a fast cyan-trail flourish, and settles into the low, coiled stance. Defeat: she staggers, drops to one knee with a knife slipping, then collapses.
sheetNotes.skill: Fan of Knives, her own special (three knives flung in a spread). Both knives are held in forward grip. 1: she crouches with both knives in forward grip, the arms drawn in close. 2: both arms swept back wide, a cyan ghost blade forming in the space between her hands. 3: she flings both arms forward and three knives release together in a spread. 4: the three knives in a wide fan at full force, cyan trails behind each blade. 5: the cyan trails fading, the arms lowering. 6: back in stance with both knives in hand.
